# ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 · PCB V1.1

The board catalog now includes an interactive educational 3D reconstruction of the official V1.1 reference layout.

- 48 CAD footprint/component groups have selectable package meshes.
- 44 J1/J3 header pads have selectable anchors and pinout details.
- BOM manufacturer part numbers are shown when the source BOM identifies them.
- Mesh identity, source coordinates, net-label provenance, and safety caveats are exposed in the board viewer.
- Most meshes are generic package shapes, not exact manufacturer-specific models.

The imported PADS board has DRC findings and unconnected items. The model is not physically validated, not a confirmed N8R8 build, and not suitable for fabrication or electrical sign-off. See [SOURCE.md](SOURCE.md) and the bundled [model notice](/models/esp32-s3-devkitc-1-v1.1.NOTICE.txt).
